title: The Circle of the Lord and the Stability of Jerusalem
english: High doctrines of truth, distinct laws and ecclesiastical canons, and with these all the saints—not only those before the epidemic but also those after it—for each of these is a circle concerning the church, so that from all of them a continuous and inseparable circle has come to be in the midst of the church.

And with these the announcements can be made, placing around those who fear the Lord the mountains that surround Jerusalem. But greater than the security of the mountains exists for the people dwelling in Jerusalem, through whom especially the one dwelling in it is not shaken for ever, the Lord becoming a circle around him. And the Lord becomes a circle not locally and bodily, limiting himself within certain bounds, but participating with them and being with all of them, not only according to the present age but also the coming one.

Regarding the rod, indeed there is a purpose to strike, to stretch out the hands of the righteous against lawlessness; but the will of the Lord is for the righteous to stretch out their hands toward righteousness, lifting them up piously without anger or inner deliberation (Ps 124:3). Good are those who have been benefited by the mindset of virtue and are straight in heart, those who truly and rightly think the things of piety (Ps 124:4). Yet these differ not in their essence but in their way of thinking. For those dwelling in Jerusalem unshakeably are all good and straight in heart, being both active and knowing. And God does good to them, giving them good things as they ask him: an addition of faith and of the rest of virtue, along with the provision of participation in divine gifts, in order to bring them into the heavenly promises and the kingdom of heaven (Ps 124:5a-b). 'He will deliver,' he says, meaning to have let go of desires toward uncleanness and toward passions of dishonor, and to stop making an unproven mind do what is not fitting. And he says also in the Psalms...
according to the inclinations of their hearts
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
